Sub: Audio recording of the Earnings Call held on October 21, 2026 for the quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations 
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the audio recording of the 
Company’s Earnings Call held on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, pertaining to the financial performance for the 
quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 is available on the Company’s website at 
https://investor.igi.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IGI-Q2-FY27-audio.mp3 
 
This intimation will be made available on the Company’s website at www.igi.org. 
 
This is for your information and record.   
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For International Gemological Institute Limited 
 
 
 
Nitika Dalmia 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer 
 
NITIKA
